Directions and Parking

Alta Villa Spa & Salon is conveniently located in the heart of downtown Pittsburgh.

Secure, covered parking is available in the Forbes Parking Garage, located on Cherry Way. Alta Villa Spa & Salon validates parking tickets for all clients.  Please bring your ticket to your appointment and receive a stamp for proof of validation before returning to the garage.
